edits.new: Include general subjects, more specific subjects, and particular instances. Name a subject itself in a heading, and place its more specific forms and particular instances beneath it. Keep details that distinguish a particular instance in its subheading rather than narrowing the general subject's heading to that instance. Give every heading and subheading its own entry; subjects may overlap or appear in multiple branches.
